transcribe.description: Turn an audio or video recording into text and wait for it. Point it at a call, a meeting, a voicemail or a podcast (upload the file, use one an earlier step produced, or paste a link) and get back everything that was said, who said it, and, if you ask, a summary, the sentiment, the topics and the names and amounts mentioned. Personal details can be taken out as it goes.
